title: Chicago Tribune, Swiatkowski death notice naming the Totosz family (19 July 1964)
citation: Death notice, William Swiatkowski, Chicago Tribune, Sunday 19 July 1964, p. 39, naming members of the Totosz family among his survivors. newspapers.com image 376257813.
notes: Bridges the gap between Ron's Chicago birth and his Des Moines life: it places the Totosz family in the Calumet City area of Illinois in 1964. Cited only for that family connection; Ron himself is not named in it.
